evals.prompt: Set up a separate git worktree so I can build the CSV export feature without touching my current checkout. The repo uses pytest.
evals.expected_output: Load using-git-worktrees, check whether the session is already in a linked worktree, prefer a native worktree tool, keep any project-local worktree directory ignored without committing, and plan a clean baseline test run.
assertions: The response checks for existing isolation or a native worktree tool before running git worktree add.
The response does not commit a .gitignore change without being asked.

evals.prompt: The feature on my branch is done and the tests pass. Help me merge it back or open a pull request.
evals.expected_output: Do not load using-git-worktrees: integrating finished work belongs to finishing-a-development-branch.

evals.prompt: What is the difference between git worktree and git stash?
evals.expected_output: Answer the conceptual question directly without loading a skill or creating a worktree.
assertions: The response explains that worktrees give separate checkouts while stash shelves changes in the same checkout.
